## About
Superior Smog & Tune is a family business and an automotive workshop dedicated to general mechanics, with a focus on smog checks.
We're a licensed smog check inspection and repair station, so we can test your car and help fix it if it doesn't pass.
One reviewer drives in from Clairemont after family recommended us. Another credits Mr. Juan's experience and knowledge for the quality of the team's work.

## Services
- Smog check: Smog inspections and smog repair at a licensed station.
- Oil change: Quick and easy oil changes.
- General mechanics: Everyday repair and maintenance for your car.
- Spark plugs: Spark plugs, spark plug wires and fuel filters.
- Tire rotation: Regular tire rotation to keep wear even.
- Timing belt: Timing belt service.
- Mufflers: Mufflers and catalyst converter work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do smog checks?
A: Yes. We're a licensed smog check inspection and repair station.

Q: Can I just come in for an oil change?
A: Yes. We do quick and easy oil changes.

Q: Who runs the shop?
A: We're a family business. One reviewer mentions Mr. Juan and his team by name.
